LeBron James (25 points, 10 rebounds, 12 assists) recorded a triple-double to propel the 76ers to a 111-104 victory tonight in Philadelphia. Giannis Antetokounmpo finished with a team-high 32 points along with 14 rebounds and 4 assists in the losing effort. The 76ers improve their record to 15-4 with the win, while the Heat fall to 10-7 for the season.
